title: Pathfinder V1 Rule Bundle
description: Schema for Pathfinder rule bundles consumed by RuleLoader. Defines deterministic condition DSL and action structure for WP8 compliance rules.

version.description: Semantic version of this rule bundle (e.g. 'gen-1000-rules-v1')

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier within the bundle (e.g. 'WP8-RULE-0001')

rule_type.description: eligibility = prerequisite check, exclusion = block path, preference = prioritised recommendation, override = force override other rules

priority.description: Execution priority (higher = evaluated first; used for conflict resolution)

applies_to.description: Stakeholder types this rule applies to. Use ['all'] for universal rules.

source_doc_ref.description: Source document or spec section that defined this rule

rule_version.description: Version tag for this specific rule (may differ from bundle version)

effective_from.description: Date from which this rule is effective (null = always)

effective_until.description: Date after which this rule expires (null = never)

parent_rule_id.description: Parent rule ID for rule versioning/overrides

condition.description: Deterministic condition DSL. One of: compound (and/or/not), atomic (field+operator+value), or empty (always true).

and.description: ALL sub-conditions must evaluate to true

or.description: ANY sub-condition must evaluate to true

not.description: Sub-condition that must evaluate to false

field.description: Field path in StakeholderState to evaluate

operator.description: Comparison operator. 'contains' checks membership in a list field. 'exists' checks non-null/non-empty.

value.description: Expected value. Type depends on the operator: scalar for eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte, array for in/not_in/contains, ignored for exists.

conditionEmpty.description: Empty condition = always true (matches all states)

text.description: Detailed action description displayed to the user

node_id.description: Suggested roadmap node to route to when this rule triggers (null = no reroute)

warning.description: Warning message appended to the path result (null = no warning)

block.description: If true, this rule BLOCKS the current path (produces a blocker in PathResult)

expected_rule_ids.description: Rule IDs that should trigger for this state (sorted alphabetically for comparison)

answers.description: Questionnaire answers including maturity scores, capabilities, missing_capabilities, regulatory_flags
